system_thesis_interpretation: This transition is a controlled test of one cognitive return edge, not yet a self-learning agent: recipient-local public experience is converted by stateless dream calls into an explicit append-only semantic graph and canonical text checkpoint; a fresh narrow thinker may expose one typed missing dependency; that selection-only record changes which bounded local evidence a later dream sees; and a new thinker reads the resulting frozen checkpoint. The only persistent within-life learning state in this rung is declarative semantic/text memory with provenance and epistemic status. No LoRA or optimizer state exists, provider/KV state is reset per call, and thinker workspace is explicit temporary state discarded at each dream boundary. Dreaming deserves credit for proposing and grounding durable local connections, the selector for allocating later views, the admission rule for public-evidence certification, and thinking for goal-specific retrieval and composition; whole-organism credit requires matched arm deltas rather than assigning all success to any one module. The smallest honest first GPU science is therefore the three-arm recurrence-closure experiment, not the presently claimed exact final-answer certification.
graph_delta_interpretation: Operationally the graph is PUBLIC EXPERIENCE -> bounded DREAM PROPOSAL -> provisional semantic node/edge -> independent PUBLIC-WITNESS ADMISSION -> canonical text MEMORY_k -> fresh THINK_k, with THINK_0 -> typed non-evidentiary frontier -> later bounded DREAM as the causal edge under test. The frontier may reorder/select a view but cannot be a premise, realization, checkpoint fact, or later citation. An action outcome could become dream evidence only after a distinct ACT -> ENVIRONMENT_FEEDBACK -> next WAKE boundary; no thinker hypothesis, release, defer, admission reason, or offline score becomes evidence. The current final branch is not the proposed final branch: V03RPublicAgendaCompiler recompiles a one-edge causal-join probe on every round, and ThinkerMachine certifies only DIRECTED_PATH reachability to the target entity. The sealed v0.3-R answer instead requires a conjunction of route/effect identification, role-anchor matching from two observations, passive-baseline and source-contribution retrieval, CHANGE-versus-STABLE branching, three-channel subtraction/normalization, and workshop-label lookup. A source-to-target edge neither denotes nor proves that answer. Three coherent graph alternatives exist. (A) Add an answer-blind CITED_SUPPORT release in which the model freely reasons, emits one schema-valid public color/state-token plus retrieved supported citations, and a gate checks only syntax, provenance, and citation availability; correctness and proof coverage are scored strictly offline. This preserves the no-solver preference but cannot call the citations a mechanically valid entailment. (B) Add a transparent DERIVE kernel whose model-selected typed operations prove role match, effect, arithmetic, normalization, and label lookup from cited public records; this can certify the answer but is explicitly a benchmark-specific solver/verifier and must be credited as such. (C) Remove final-answer release from this transition and use the existing directed-path machine only for post-return recurrence closure. C is the recommended smallest honest GPU graph; A is the least invasive choice if final behavioral accuracy must remain in the same frozen run; B is appropriate only if Rohin explicitly prefers proof certification over the no-embedded-solver constraint.
loop_delta_interpretation: Each logical life executes one physical shared prefix: every public event triggers one WAKE dream, periodic REACTIVATE calls are interleaved, sixteen target-blind SLEEP calls follow, MEMORY_0 freezes, and a fresh at-most-12-operation THINK_0 either finds the own join or produces one mechanically projected missing/conflict frontier. The identical MEMORY_0/THINK_0 bytes are cloned into no-feedback, own-agenda, and recipient-local matched-distractor arms. Each arm receives sixteen RETURN_SLEEP calls, freezes MEMORY_1, and starts a fresh thinker with no inherited workspace. Seeds 0 and 2 contribute 132 dream calls per life, seed 1 contributes 137, totaling 802 physical dream calls across six lives; thinker work is bounded by 288 operations in the unchanged proposal, actual calls/tokens are reported, and early terminal states are not padded. Calls at the same causal phase may batch, but phase order and life/arm isolation may not cross. The remote-marker loop adds durability only: it may resume observation and artifact transfer, never scientific repair, inference of success, duplicate launch, follow-up, or claim promotion. For the recommended C split, MEMORY_1 is queried only for the exact public recurrence probe and the run stops at offline closure/attribution scoring. Under A, the final public question is revealed after MEMORY_1 and the free reasoner may release a cited answer, but the online system does not decide whether the answer follows; under B, every derivation operation is replayed by the disclosed proof kernel. In all three cases poor performance completes the frozen valid run, integrity failure stops it, and every result terminates at the human boundary.
claim_delta_interpretation: As written, the proposal overclaims the certification path. The existing machinery can support only: own goal-conditioned feedback changes bounded later-dream selection and may increase formation/admission and fresh retrieval of the requested recipient-local causal connection relative to no feedback and a matched irrelevant frontier. It cannot support 'fresh final thinker reconstructs the paired decision with mechanically valid cited support,' because DIRECTED_PATH proves only graph reachability and the current compiler ignores the final question. Under A, a positive paired answer delta would be an offline-scored behavioral result accompanied by citations, not a proof-valid release; correct answers could still arise from unsupported scratch reasoning or guessing, so closure, citation coverage, and answer accuracy must remain separate outcomes. Under B, proof-valid final answers are possible, but the result measures a model operating a disclosed domain proof/calculation kernel. Under C, paired arithmetic accuracy, final-context/RAG comparisons, and any statement that the new edge was used to solve the final task are deferred. No alternative supports LoRA, action improvement, heldout robustness, learned scheduling, scaling, self-improvement, or headline promotion.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The declared matrix is directionally correct: dreams see one public trigger and at most six recipient-local semantic neighbors; pre-final thinkers see only an immutable checkpoint and the public operational probe; return dreams may see the own or matched typed focus but never the final question or truth; final thinking alone may see the public final question; hidden answer/private world/oracle and offline scores are scorer-only after commitment. Provider calls are stateless, while explicit thinker state is serialized between operations inside one THINK phase and discarded before the next. One important qualification is that selection_focus exposes the requested left endpoint, relation, and right endpoint to RETURN_SLEEP. This is legitimate attention, but the model is grounding a supplied candidate relation, not discovering its identity from scratch. Mechanical admission is non-generative only if the proposal is committed before checking, the checker never enumerates/substitutes endpoints or citations, a failed check cannot be used for rejection-sampling retries, and proposal-generation accuracy is reported separately from admission accuracy. On those terms it is not hidden-answer cheating: it checks a narrow public witness grammar and never computes the final answer. The current implementation is weaker than that contract: the causal-edge proposal has no declared connector/effect field to compare, and failed causal admissions are dropped rather than retained provisional, so repeated calls can use absence as a one-bit validator. Without an append-only failed/provisional record plus a no-retry/tombstone rule, the admission loop can become generative search assistance even though each individual checker invocation does not propose an edge.
acceptance_test_interpretation: In list order: (1) trusted reconstruction/replay is necessary and tests the advertised anti-forgery boundary; (2) exact provider bytes, resets, and receipts test the thinker call boundary; (3) the analogous dream bijection tests model-to-memory provenance; (4) the admission test is insufficient until it also proves no-proposal/no-edge, no endpoint or citation substitution, explicit connector/effect agreement or a narrowed connectivity claim, append-only provisional/tombstone handling, and no retry channel from failure; (5) physical shared-prefix accounting and matched attributed envelopes test causal compute equality; (6) the 1000-pair shortcut gate tests benchmark identifiability but cannot repair a thinker contract mismatch; (7) the proposed final-goal test is presently unsatisfiable because DIRECTED_PATH cannot certify the answer and must be replaced by a post-return closure test under C, by a syntax/provenance-only cited-release plus offline scoring test under A, or by full proof-operation mutation tests under B; (8) manifest-bound 46/49 WAKE, 22/24 REACTIVATE, arm equality, and total 802 test the actual schedule; (9) complete captured bytes and private/final sentinel mutation test visibility timing; (10) bounded-view and frontier-as-non-evidence attacks test the return edge, but should additionally ensure the supplied focus is never credited as discovery; (11) under C baselines must be closure/selection baselines, while full-context/RAG final-answer baselines belong with A or a later final-goal transition; (12) quiescent closure and two binding independent reviews are valid launch gates; (13) authoritative remote markers test persistence without duplicating authority; (14) the full manifest tests post-hoc causal attribution; (15) exact human scope remains mandatory and must bind whichever A/B/C bytes replace the current proposal; and (16) every analyst route must stop at a human so one development result cannot self-expand. Thus tests 1-3, 5-6, 8-10, and 12-16 are necessary links, while tests 4, 7, and 11 require the stated disposition before GPU launch.
assumptions: Every collision-twin life and experimental arm has an isolated explicit state namespace, fresh provider sessions, and no shared cache, retrieval index, KV state, adapter, or workspace beyond the declared physically shared prefix.
The final public answer is a color/state-token obtained from conjunctive public evidence and conditional arithmetic, not the target entity reached by the recurrence-probe edge.
A supports only answer-blind schema/provenance checking online; any judgment that citations entail the answer occurs after immutable commitment and cannot steer or authorize another run.

C retains all six development lives and all three matched arms because both the no-feedback and same-kind distractor controls are necessary to identify targeted recurrence rather than extra dreaming or generic salience.
No text checkpoint, canonical realization, or repeated touch is LoRA-parametric memory in this transition; all durable learned content is explicit declarative state.

ambiguities.question: Does Rohin want the first GPU transition to make the narrow recurrence-closure claim only, or retain exploratory final-answer behavior through answer-blind CITED_SUPPORT despite losing mechanical entailment certification?
ambiguities.impact: This selects C versus A, changes the final thinker contract, required baselines, acceptance test 7, and the strongest allowed claim.

ambiguities.question: Is the admitted durable object only source-to-target connectivity, or a typed connector-and-effect-bearing causal record?
ambiguities.impact: The current semantic edge stores neither connector nor CHANGE/STABLE effect, so the latter interpretation requires an ontology/schema change before admission can check equality.

ambiguities.question: Must a failed public-witness check commit the exact proposal as provisional or a non-retriable tombstone, and what admission-status information may later dream calls observe?
ambiguities.impact: Dropping failures permits repeated attempts to turn the checker into a search oracle, undermining the claim that admission is non-generative.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal cannot truthfully claim or test a mechanically valid final paired-answer RELEASE with the current DIRECTED_PATH thinker.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The compiler rebuilds the operational causal-join probe even after final reveal, DIRECTED_PATH outputs the target entity rather than a color/state-token, and one edge omits the role, baseline, contribution, effect branch, arithmetic, normalization, and label evidence required by the public goal.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Prefer C: ratify a recurrence-closure-only first GPU transition and defer the final task. If final behavior is required now, use A and explicitly call it free model reasoning with supported citations and offline-only correctness/proof scoring. Use B only after explicit human acceptance that the transparent DERIVE grammar is an embedded benchmark solver/verifier.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The present admission contract does not yet justify calling public-witness promotion fully non-generative.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The checker does not globally search or substitute endpoints, which is good, but the proposal has no declared connector/effect field to compare and a rejected edge is dropped. Across sixteen return calls, disappearance can signal failure and allow retries, making the gate an implicit validator-assisted search loop.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Commit every parsed proposal and exact admission result append-only, retain failed joins as provisional or install a conclusion-level non-retriable tombstone, expose no rejection rationale to generation, prohibit repeated proposals for the same semantic conclusion, and either add typed connector/effect fields or narrow the admitted claim to connectivity. Report raw proposal, admission, and downstream use separately.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The agenda arm should not be described as discovering the requested relation identity independently.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: RETURN_SLEEP model bytes include the complete left/relation/right selection focus. The model still must retrieve and cite recipient-local public witnesses, but the candidate edge is supplied as attention.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State the causal claim as agenda-guided grounding or witness-backed formation of a requested local connection, reserve discovery credit for an ablation that hides candidate endpoints/relation, and keep the matched-distractor arm to measure whether the supplied focus is causally useful.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The current acceptance-test set cannot release the exact proposed GPU science unchanged.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The final-goal test advertises an answer theorem the machine cannot express, the admission test permits reject-or-provisional behavior that does not close the retry channel, and the baseline test conflates closure science with final-answer science if C is selected.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Revise and re-bind tests 4, 7, and 11 to the chosen A/B/C architecture, then require the ordinary fresh cross-critique, consensus, human ratification, and immutable dual review over those exact bytes.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify C, the recommended recurrence-closure-only first GPU science, or explicitly choose A's weaker offline-scored cited answer behavior or B's transparent embedded proof kernel?
Does Rohin accept the proposed no-retry/tombstone and explicit connector/effect disposition as the condition under which mechanical public-witness admission is non-generative?

After the chosen architecture and replacement tests are hash-bound and independently reviewed, does Rohin authorize only the already proposed GPU and bound postcommit-analysis scope, with no follow-up, repair, LoRA, heldout access, or claim promotion?
